evidence_class.description: Recurrence provenance only. Do not use falsification classes such as OBSERVED_TEST/OBSERVED_RUNTIME/OBSERVED_READBACK here.
Falsification execution state only. Do not use recurrence provenance classes such as OBSERVED_HISTORY/OBSERVED_SOURCE/OBSERVED_LIVE here.

attempted_sources.description: V0.5: accessible surfaces actually consulted before declaring the gap. Each evidence_id must resolve in the external evidence manifest.

uncertainty_id.description: V0.5: required for DESIGN_BLOCKING rows; referenced by blocked material_process_graph nodes.

blocking_uncertainty_id.description: V0.5: required when disposition=DESIGN_BLOCKING; names the DESIGN_BLOCKING current_uncertainty (and so its attempted_sources).

case_mode.description: V0.5: INCIDENT_REPAIR explains a recurring failure class; ARCHITECTURE_AUDIT maps and repairs a process/lifecycle without a triggering incident. Audit mode relaxes only recurrence evidence and the incident-length causal chain; systemic causality and controls (immediate_cause, systemic_root_cause, first_bad_control, escape_control) remain mandatory.
